video_title: On Set with LaMelo Ball at the NBA on Prime Commercial Shoot | Minnesota Timberwolves All-Access

quotes.speaker: Pierce Marchant
quotes.summary_phrase: Amazon's strategy for NBA on Prime player marketing
quotes.excerpt: we think about exciting players, ascending players, stars obviously and like LaMelo is all those things
quotes.quote: We are here in Culver City. We are doing our shoot for the NBA on Prime this coming season. We are shooting a bunch of players here on site, capturing them for our upcoming commercials for the NBA on Prime this season. Having LaMelo is huge for us. When we think about the NBA on Prime, we think about exciting players, ascending players, stars obviously and like LaMelo is all those things and we can't wait to have him in the spot, we can't wait to have him for the season and so he was an obvious pick for us.

quotes.speaker: LaMelo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball and Cade Cunningham choreographing a commercial move
quotes.excerpt: you are going to do a left to right. On the crossover you are going to still with your left hand

text_blocks.speaker: LaMelo Ball
text_blocks.text: You want to do a step of the ball, you do a left to right. On the crossover you are going to still with your left hand. So go do slow. Do it without. Boom. Not like that, but you will get to steal like real.

text_blocks.speaker: Cade Cunningham
text_blocks.text: He is going to cross over you and you can throw it, you do a lot of underhand passes so make it chill.

quotes.speaker: LaMelo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball on his approach to the game and next level
quotes.excerpt: as long as I get to the next level, I am good
quotes.quote: You know I am a chill guy. As long as I get to the next level, I am good. And where we are at right now, the next level. I am good.
